messages:
maria (AE): @acme-secops thanks for the questionnaire PDF. procurement is asking for a control matrix + SOC2 artifacts before the POC kickoff. can you confirm exact items you need?
acme-secops (AcmeCorp): hi maria — they asked for: SOC2 report or SOC2 summary, ISO scope statement, control mapping (CSV), and a signed penetration test attestation/letter. timeline is 2 weeks if possible. also need clarification if POC must be in Dedicated env for compliance.
sam (SE): we can provide a control matrix export and a SOC2 summary PDF under NDA. for pen-test: we have a third-party pentest summary and a templated attestation letter that security can sign. Dedicated vs Hosted affects controls around data residency & key management — pricing will change.
jamal (Security): quick notes: we can share the latest SOC2 Type II summary (redacted) and the control mapping (maps our controls to common frameworks) — will need an NDA for full report. for pen-test attestation we have two options: 1) signed letter confirming third-party test and remediation status, or 2) signed attestation of no recent critical findings if you can't receive the full report. for Dedicated/on-prem we also need to share architecture diagram + HSM/KMS details.
elaine (Legal): @acme-secops please confirm the recipient email(s) for the SOC2 artifact and whether we can share under our standard limited-scope NDA. if you need the full SOC2 report we will route via our security-portal signed access only. I can prep the attestation signature once security signs off.
acme-secops (AcmeCorp): recipients: security.team@acmecorp.com and procurement@acmecorp.com. NDA is fine. Prefer the signed pen-test letter rather than full report. Dedicated is preferred but can start on hosted if timeline tight — pricing impact?
sam (SE): pricing: short answer — Dedicated will add a monthly commitment and a setup fee. for POC we can offer a time-limited Dedicated trial (7–14 days) at reduced rate to validate performance. I'll ping pricing and get a quick estimate.
jamal (Security): action items from us: upload control matrix CSV, SOC2 summary PDF (redacted), pen-test attestation draft for legal signature, architecture diagram for Dedicated. timeframe: I can have drafts in 3 business days if NDA signed.
elaine (Legal): I'll send the NDA + redwood attestation template. once NDA is signed, we can attach the SOC2 summary and the attestation letter. expect legal turnaround ~48 hours.
maria (AE): plan summary for acme: 1) we'll DM NDA link (elaine). 2) once signed, jamal will upload: control_matrix_acme.csv, soc2_summary_acme.pdf, pentest_attestation_acme.pdf, dedicated_arch_diagram.png to a secure bucket. 3) sam will provide Dedicated trial pricing ETA. 4) we'll provide time-limited staging creds if you need to run ingest tests. ETA: artifacts in ~3 business days after NDA. good? :thumbsup:
acme-secops (AcmeCorp): sounds good. please share the S3 upload link and we'll confirm recipients.
audit-bot: Artifact upload scheduled: s3://redwood-compliance/acmecorp/2123456789/ (private). link will be active for recipients after NDA complete.
maria (AE): thanks team — owners: elaine (NDA), jamal (artifacts), sam (pricing & Dedicated trial). I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a POC kickoff after artifacts are shared.
acme-secops (AcmeCorp): appreciate it, team. tight timeline but sounds workable. will review NDA today.
sam (SE): pricing ETA by EOD tomorrow.
jamal (Security): I'll draft the pen-test attestation using our standard wording. sample snippet: 
```
Redwood Inference attests that a third-party penetration test was completed on MM/DD/YYYY with no unresolved critical findings. A signed copy of the full report can be provided under NDA.
```
maria (AE): perfect — closing thread once NDA signed and artifacts uploaded. thanks everyone. :rocket:
